purpose: Verbatim transcription registry for Lindqvist (1989) POAC'89 and Riska ice resistance formulas. An entry may only be created by copying characters from an authorised copy of the source document held by the operator: quote (verbatim, character exact), table/figure/page locator, and the numeric values exactly as printed (as strings, no re-rounding). The anchor reconciliation script refuses to promote any anchor whose entry is not VERBATIM.

entry_schema.anchor_id: string, stable key used by the reconciliation script
entry_schema.quote: character-exact sentence(s) from the document containing the anchor value and its nondimensionalisation

values.printed_value: string, exactly as printed (no re-rounding, no unit conversion)

entry_schema.operator: who transcribed, from which copy (edition, ISBN/accession), and the date
entry_schema.verification: second-person re-read result; two independent readings required before verbatim_status=VERBATIM

promotion_rule: An entry with verbatim_status != VERBATIM, or with an empty quote, or without a page/table locator, is claim_ineligible: its numbers may only be used as a cross-check against computed values, never as a basis for a pass/compliance statement. The generator script enforces this (see benchmarks/anchors/lindqvist_riska_anchor.py, function classify_entries).
